nodes.rationale: Sidecar mode provides optional security scanning via /api/scan endpoint; does NOT guarantee all traffic is scanned unlike proxy/secure mode which intercepts all traffic. Chosen to allow optional integration without forcing all traffic through gateway.

nodes.label: VPNKit Userspace Networking Fix
nodes.rationale: Cisco AnyConnect pf anchor blocks Docker container egress via gVisor VM networking. Fix: switch NetworkType to vpnkit-userspace so connections originate as macOS host process traffic, bypassing AnyConnect pf rules. Also disable VpnKitTransparentProxy to remove the fragile HTTPS proxy chain.

nodes.label: Gateway op-proxy Credential Flow
nodes.rationale: 1Password service account token lives on the gateway, not in the bot container. Bot retrieves credentials via op-wrapper.sh -> gateway /credentials/op-proxy, which validates allowlist before calling op read. This enforces least-privilege credential access and prevents direct 1Password access from agent containers.

nodes.label: Credential Security Rule: Never Display in Chat
nodes.rationale: Ultra-conservative approach: never display credentials in any chat interface because (1) chat creates persistent records, (2) can't reliably verify which interface is trusted, (3) session hijacking risk, (4) simple absolute rules are consistently followed. Console and 1Password app remain as secure viewing options.
nodes.norm_label: credential security rule: never display in chat

nodes.label: Defense in Depth — Security Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Multiple independent security layers each enforcing a different aspect of safety. If one layer fails, others still protect. Every layer defaults to fail-closed (block by default, allow explicitly). Transparent proxy — works with any AI agent framework without modifying the agent itself.

nodes.label: MiddlewareManager
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates 7 security modules. Had a fail-open on init flaw (guard silently skipped if init fails) flagged in 2026-02-23 review; should be fail-closed if a critical guard cannot initialize.

nodes.label: SecurityPipeline Architecture
nodes.rationale: Chains PromptGuard -> TrustManager -> EgressFilter -> PII Sanitizer -> Approval Queue in a fail-closed pipeline. Defense-in-depth rationale: even if one layer is bypassed, subsequent layers catch the attack.

nodes.label: Security Theater Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: Defined as controls that appear to provide security but provide zero functional protection (hardcoded stats dashboards, kill switch alerts that just show alert(), empty test files). Contrasted with genuine security value.

nodes.label: PII Detection Pipeline (Presidio + Regex)
nodes.rationale: Hybrid Presidio + regex approach. Presidio runs first, then regex fallback for SSN/phone that spaCy en_core_web_sm misses. Cross-Python 3.9-3.14+ compatibility required.

nodes.label: Observatory Mode API
nodes.rationale: GET/PUT /api/mode endpoint with auto-revert timer (clamped 1-480 minutes). Allows temporary monitor mode with guaranteed revert to enforce. If gateway restarts during monitor mode, defaults to enforce - safe by design.

nodes.label: OWNER_USER_IDS Bypass Mechanism
nodes.rationale: ContextGuard and FileSandbox skip scanning for hardcoded owner Telegram IDs to reduce false positives on admin commands. Risk: bypass scope too broad; no audit trail for bypassed checks; should be moved to config not source code.

nodes.label: Supply Chain Hardening (Image Pinning, Checksum Verification)
nodes.rationale: Base images pinned to SHA256 digests, Trivy installed with checksum verification, 1Password CLI with GPG signature verification. setuid/setgid bits stripped (CIS 4.8 compliance).
nodes.norm_label: supply chain hardening (image pinning, checksum verification)

nodes.label: Scoped WebSocket Tokens
nodes.rationale: Short-lived (5min), single-use, ws_-prefixed tokens for WebSocket auth. Prevents master auth token from being exposed in server logs or browser history.

nodes.label: Docker Network Isolation (internal: true)
nodes.source_location: H4 Docker Network Not Actually Isolated

nodes.label: Seccomp Syscall Filtering
nodes.rationale: Blocks exotic syscalls (bpf, perf_event_open, kexec_load) to prevent container escape via kernel exploit. Critical for external hosting scenarios where provider may have malicious host access.

nodes.label: Read-Only Container Filesystem
nodes.rationale: Prevents bot from modifying container OS/system files. Bot can write to workspace volumes and tmpfs but not /usr/bin, /etc, /lib. Blocks prompt injection attacks that try to write to /etc/crontab or install rootkits.

nodes.label: ML-Based Injection Classifier (DistilBERT)
nodes.rationale: Proposed as secondary check when regex score is 0.3-0.8 (uncertain zone). Would catch semantic equivalents that regex misses. Marked as stub/not implemented in v0.8.0 assessment.

nodes.label: 1Password op-proxy Credential Isolation
nodes.rationale: Keeps OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN on gateway, not bot. Allowlist with glob patterns + path traversal rejection. Prevents credential exfiltration via Telegram chat.

nodes.label: v0.8.0 Watchtower Enforcement Hardening
nodes.rationale: Core objective: flip all security modules from monitor to enforce mode. DNSFilter, EgressMonitor, SubagentMonitor, KillSwitch all flipped. ContextGuard, OutputCanary, EnhancedToolResultSanitizer wired into SecurityPipeline.
